content.title: Where to Watch Every WrestleMania
content.text: WWE isn’t just about grit and aggression — it’s where passion meets power, where heart meets hype, and where drama unfolds in the ring. Keeping you hooked with larger-than-life Superstars and non-stop action, WrestleMania takes it to the next level with jaw-dropping moments, roaring crowds, and the kind of action you can’t look away from. Every WrestleMania – all 41 of them to date – is available to stream on Peacock, but here are three to get you started on your WWE journey.1. Wrestlemania (2003)WrestleMania 19 delivered a lineup of action-packed moments, but the true standout was the epic showdown between “Stone Cold” Steve Austin and The Rock, aka Dwayne Johnson. The clash marked their third and final WrestleMania battle. This time, The Rock scored his first one-on-one win over Stone Cold. Even more iconic, it was Austin’s last match before retiring, making the moment both historic and emotional. Stream WrestleMania 19 on Peacock. 2. WrestleMania 40 (2024) Reminding fans exactly why it’s called “The Grandest Stage of Them All,” WrestleMania 40 celebrated four decades of legendary moments. The two-night event in Philadelphia was full of energy, emotion, and electricity. The highlight of the event was Cody Rhodes finally “finishing the story,” toppling Roman Reigns to end his epic title reign and claim the Undisputed WWE Universal Championship. Filled with surprising returns, the milestone event is a knockout to watch. Stream WrestleMania 40 on Peacock. 3. WrestleMania 41 (2025) WWE lit up Las Vegas for WrestleMania 41, bringing high-stakes matches and major shake-ups. Jey Uso captured his first World Heavyweight Championship, while John Cena, in his final WrestleMania appearance before he retires at the end of 2025, nabbed his record-breaking 17th world championship. Add Dominik Mysterio winning Intercontinental gold and a surprise appearance from Travis Scott, and this WrestleMania had everything. If you missed it live, now’s the time to dive into all the chaos, the triumphs, and the unforgettable moments. Stream WrestleMania 41 on Peacock. WrestleMania is where WWE history is made. You can watch every WrestleMania, along with every WWE Premium Live Event, on Peacock. Relive classic moments, experience all the drama as it happened, and see the legendary matches that the WWE Universe still talks about to this day. Just get the Peacock app, navigate to the WWE section and start your WrestleMania journey. Stream the full WrestleMania collection now on Peacock.
